Introduction
This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I3, to be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category.
Maintenance staff should be well trained and 
 qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, 
 safety belt when cleaning 
 suspension insulators etc.
Transformer must be out 
 of service, isolated and grounded from both sides.
Isolate 
 the LV transformer and taking out the 6kv breaker out 
 of bus bar 6kv.
Disconnect supply of DC.
Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of the transformers, 
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, 
 and tool set
Complete tool kit/set, 
 including a torque wrench.
Fine cloth for cleaning 
 purposes, Silica gel
Voltage indicator, ( HV tester 
 rod ), Megger.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean all 
 porcelain surfaces.
Inspect all 
 painted surface, remove any signs of rust and repaint bare spots.
Check for 
 signs of oil leaks.
Check oil 
 level in tank and conservator .
Check the 
 condition of the silica gel, replace silica gel if its color changed from 
 blue to pink.
Check the 
 condition of earthing.
All bolted 
 connections must be checked for tightness.
Clean the 
 body, cables and the room of service transformer.
Check the 
 break point for oil
Check the 
 coils of the transformers .
Perform 
 a megger test for coils .
